description: This file defines the OpenTag class within the Goteo project, managing operations related to open tags for projects, including retrieval, list generation, validation, saving, and ordering mechanisms.

classes.name: OpenTag
classes.description: Model class representing open tags for projects, providing methods for CRUD operations, listing, and ordering.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of language-specific fields used for localization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific open tag by its ID, supporting localization.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all open tags with their associated data, including usage count.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a list of open tags used in published projects, filtered by current language.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the OpenTag object, checking for required fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current OpenTag object to the database, performing insert or update.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Reorders the open tag to move it higher in the sequence.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Reorders the open tag to move it lower in the sequence.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Determines the next order value for adding a new open tag.
